points.point: X-figure: opposite = vertically opposite; side-by-side on a line = linear pair.

Axiom 6.1 and 6.2 are converses; together = Linear Pair Axiom.
Proof skeleton: LP sum 180 + LP sum 180 ⇒ VO angles equal; then apply to numericals.
